The present Special Civil Application is filed praying for the following reliefs :

That this Honourable Court may be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or a writ in the nature of Mandamus and/or any other appropriate writ or order or direction upon the respondent toforward the pending reference applications dated 11/02/2014 filed by the petitioner's u/s 18 of the land acquisition act (Annxure- A) to the Hon'ble Reference court having the jurisdiction to decide the same or in the alternative A. respondent herein to reconstruct the copy of reference applications by accepting photo copy from the petitioners and forward it to the Hon'ble Reference court having jurisdiction to decide.

sentences.text: That this Honourable Court be pleased to pass such other further orders as the nature and circumstances of the case may demand, And for this act of kindness and justice, the petitioners herein, as in duty bound, shall for every pray."

2. It is submitted by the learned counsel Mr.R.R. Patel that the petitioners have filed Land Reference Applications under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, before the office of respondent No.1 for enhancement of compensation, which have been registered in the reference register at Sr. Nos.629 to 638.
It however, seems that said reference applications have been further submitted to the Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Viramgam.

entities.text: Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Viramgam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/4365/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined 3.

It is further submitted that since the original records are not traceable, the respondent authority shall have to reconstruct the reference applications, which have been filed by the petitioners herein.
As no action is being taken by the authorities, the petitioners are constrained to file the present Special Civil Application.

4. Learned AGP Mr.Ashutosh Dave, on instructions of nd Shri V.A. Panchal, 2 Land Acquisition Officer & Deputy Collector, Ahmedabad, submits that now the reference applications as filed by the petitioners have been reconstructed and the same would be forwarded to the Court of learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Viramgam within a period of 10 days and in any case before 31.07.2023.
5.

In view of the statement by the learned AGP, on nd instructions of Shri V.A. Panchal, 2 Land Acquisition Officer & Deputy Collector, Ahmedabad, the learned advocate for the petitioners does not press for the reliefs since the same would become infructuous once action is taken by the respondent-authority.

The present Special Civil Application is disposed of on the basis of the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/4365/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined statement as made by the learned AGP and recorded hereinabove.
6.
The petitioners shall be at liberty to approach this Court in case of any difficulty.

(ANIRUDDHA P. MAYEE, J.) KUMAR ALOK Thakor Ramesh Mafaji vs Second Additional Special Land ... on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164122651/
